mapper.select: select pr.rabbit_id as rabbitId, count(1) as totalLitters, ifnull(sum(pr.total_kits), 0) as totalKits, ifnull(sum(pr.live_kits), 0) as totalLiveKits, max(pr.birth_date) as lastLitterDate from parturition_records pr join batches b on pr.batch_id = b.id where pr.house_id = #{houseId} and b.house_id = #{houseId} group by pr.rabbit_id

select wr.rabbit_id as rabbitId, ifnull(sum(wr.weaning_count), 0) as totalWeaned from weaning_records wr join batches b on wr.batch_id = b.id where wr.house_id = #{houseId} and b.house_id = #{houseId} group by wr.rabbit_id

select pcr.rabbit_id as rabbitId, ifnull(sum(case when pcr.result = '怀孕' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successBreedingCount, ifnull(sum(case when pcr.result = '空怀' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failedBreedingCount from pregnancy_check_records pcr join batches b on pcr.batch_id = b.id where pcr.house_id = #{houseId} and b.house_id = #{houseId} group by pcr.rabbit_id
